Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 22 Dulwich Hill Station South Precinct 22

Clause 9.22.1 - heritage (heritage_protection): The precinct contains part of the South Dulwich Hill Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.22.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exists within the precinct.

Clause 9.22.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect the identified values of the South Dulwich Hill Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.22.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect and enhance the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.22.2 - other (development_control): To ensure that higher density development demonstrates good urban design and environmental sustainability and provides suitable amenity for occupants of those developments .

Clause 9.22.2 - other (development_control): To ensure the design of higher density development protects the residential amenity of adjoining and surrounding properties .
